title: Gift Play - Earn Game Codes
meta_description: Earn game codes by playing in-app games. Lots of steam keys, wallet codes.
full_description: Here is the “Gift Play”. Just play in-app games and get free game gift codes, random keys, PINs and in-game goods.All you need is playing the wheel of fortune. Collect golds and get your stuff from the Gift Play Store. You will see your gift codes (PIN) in the inventory page.Game codes in the store are refreshing every day. New game codes and wallet codes are available. You can get Steam games only in 20 - 25 minutes of play. So it’s very easy to get the games right into your Steam account.Gift Play is not a “watch-n-earn” application. Everything is organic and enjoyable. New features will be coming soon. So stay Tuned!All you need is a Google account. Then you can start to collect golds and earn gift codes! Application is secure 100% and there is no risk of fraud.In the “Magic Safe” section, there are lots of locked items waiting for you. All you need is try random numbers and guess the password. If you can guess the password correctly, then you will get the item (game gift card) directly in your inventory. More locked items added every Monday. But yes: they are not enough. If you wish to see new game codes and PINs in the store, don’t hesitate to contact us! We will add new codes to the store based on the players’ feedback!Download NowGet free games right now.
